title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation

Período do contrato: 10 dias úteis (incluindo treinamento) – Temporário

Local: Brasília, Brasil

Descrição da vaga:

A Aceolution está contratando com urgência Representantes de Coleta de Dados em Campo em Taipei, Taiwan, para verificar pontos de interesse (POI) com base em instruções específicas de pesquisa. Isso envolverá deslocamentos a pé até os locais designados.


No entanto, os participantes podem usar bicicletas/patinetes/outros meios de transporte, se desejarem.

Verificação a pé de POIs (Pontos de Interesse), que podem incluir hotéis, postos de gasolina, restaurantes e estabelecimentos similares.

Residir em Brasília ou arredores, Brasil

Proficiência em inglês (leitura e conversação)

Capacidade de se deslocar a pé ou utilizar transporte para verificar o POI (Ponto de Interesse)



Job Title: Field Data Representative

Employment Type: Regular, full-time. Monday to Friday

Contract period: 10 Days work include training

Location: Brasília, Brazil.


Job Description:

Aceolution is urgently hiring Field Data Representatives in Águas Claras, Federal District, Brazil to verify points of interest (POI) based on specific survey instructions. This will involve walking in assigned locations.

However, workers are free to use bike/scooter/other transport if he wants.

Pedestrian verification of POIs (Point of Interest) which can be amongst hotels, gas stations, restaurants and the likes. We recommend on-feet collection; however, workers are free to use bike/scooter/other transport if he/she wants.


Requirements:

  • English proficiency (read and speak)
  • Ability to walk or use other means of transport for POI verification

title: Data Analyst V
description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Modelo de trabalho: Home office


Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.


O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
  • Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).
  • Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: ServiceNow Applications Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) ServiceNow Applications Engineer com forte expertise em AppEngine , desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas e automação de processos, para atuar em um ambiente altamente técnico e colaborativo.

O(a) profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento, governança de plataforma e soluções de automação industrial, combinando visão estratégica, excelência técnica e interação com múltiplas áreas do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e workflows customizados em ServiceNow (AppEngine, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub)
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e aderentes às melhores práticas da plataforma
  • Integrar ServiceNow com sistemas externos via REST/SOAP
  • Criar e manter Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs e UI Policies
  • Orientar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, incluindo code reviews e mentoring
  • Garantir governança da plataforma, reusabilidade e qualidade técnica das entregas
  • Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações de processo e automação industrial, utilizando tecnologias de Controle Avançado e Otimizadores em tempo real
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e colaborando em melhorias cross-funcionais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Experiência sólida com:
  • JavaScript e Glide API
  • ServiceNow AppEngine
  • Flow Designer
  • Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs, UI Policies
  • Integrações via REST/SOAP
  • Experiência com HRSD, S2P e outros módulos/plugins ServiceNow
  • Vivência com DevOps, ATF e GitHub
  • Experiência em automação industrial / controle de processos
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de refino e processos químicos
  • Experiência com Multivariable Predictive Control (AspenTech DMC, Honeywell RMPCT)
  • Experiência com Real-Time Optimizers (RoMeo ou similares)


Diferenciais

  • Certificações ServiceNow:
  • Flow Designer
  • IntegrationHub
  • Automated Test Framework
  • Service Portal
  • Performance Analytics
  • CSA (Certified System Administrator)
  • CAD (Certified Application Developer)
  • CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist)
  • CTA (Certified Technical Architect)


Onde você vai trabalhar?

100% remoto. No conforto de sua casa.

title: DESENVOLVIMENTO E PROGRAMACAO ESPECIALISTA
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvimento e Programação Especialista (DEVES) para se juntar ao nosso time. Este profissional será responsável por desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar integrações em IBM ACE, garantindo alta disponibilidade e performance. Além disso, irá projetar e implementar APIs e serviços SOA, seguindo padrões corporativos de arquitetura e conduzir iniciativas de modernização de integrações, reduzindo acoplamento e aumentando escalabilidade. O(a) DEVES também apoiará a evolução para arquiteturas cloud-native, integrando soluções on-premise e cloud, garantindo padrões de segurança, governança e qualidade de código.


Requisitos Necessários:

- Experiência sólida com IBM App Connect Enterprise (ACE) / IBM Integration Bus (IIB) em ambientes produtivos.

- Forte conhecimento em arquitetura de integração, APIs REST/SOAP, mensageria e padrões SOA.

- Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento e sustentação de APIs corporativas, incluindo versionamento, segurança e governança.

- Vivência em modernização de integrações legadas, migrando soluções monolíticas ou ESB tradicionais para arquiteturas mais modernas.

- Experiência prática com Java e/ou Go aplicados a integrações e serviços.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For


Must-Have Experience

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

• Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined


Nice to Have

• Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

• Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

• Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

• Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up


How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.


We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.


What You'll Get

• Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

• A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

  • Antecipar complexidades técnicas
  • Estimar esforços com precisão
  • Sugerir alternativas técnicas para acelerar o time-to-market


Integração Sistêmica (Backend)

  • Liderar, junto ao time de Backend, a definição de contratos de API e arquitetura de dados
  • Garantir performance, segurança e economia de recursos no mobile


3. Governança e Sustentação

Gestão de Incidentes (L3)

  • Atuar na resolução de bugs críticos e problemas complexos em produção
  • Realizar análise de causa raiz
  • Propor melhorias estruturais para evitar recorrências


Estratégia de Homologação

  • Estabelecer padrões de testes automatizados (unitários, widget e integração)

  • Garantir consistência entre Android e iOS com mínima intervenção manual

Experiência e Layout

  • Atuar junto ao time de Design para discutir usabilidade e viabilidade técnica


Otimização de Alto Nível

  • Avaliar e decidir adoção de novas bibliotecas ou ferramentas com ganho real de produtividade


Mitigação de Riscos e Débito Técnico

  • Identificar débitos técnicos e riscos de integração
  • Gerir riscos de forma proativa
  • Propor planos de refatoração sem bloquear entregas de negócio

Pessoas que:

Hard Skills

  • Têm domínio profundo de Flutter e Dart, incluindo a engine do Flutter e o ciclo de vida da linguagem
  • Têm experiência sólida em desenvolvimento e deploy para Android, iOS e Flutter Web
  • Compreendem as nuances de cada plataforma, incluindo gerenciamento de janelas, navegação web e mobile e bibliotecas específicas
  • Dominam arquiteturas escaláveis, como Clean Architecture e MVVM
  • Aplicam padrões de projeto que facilitam o reaproveitamento de código entre Web e Mobile
  • Têm experiência com Bloc ou Riverpod em projetos de alta complexidade e larga escala
  • Criam layouts responsivos e adaptativos com fidelidade ao Figma em diferentes plataformas
  • Dominam a pirâmide de testes (unitários, widget e integração)

  • Debugam memory leaks e otimizam o tamanho do bundle web

title: Data Engineer with Databricks (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience as a Data Engineer;
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks;
  • Experience working with Microsoft Azure services;
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal;
  • B2 English is mandatory.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote/on-site;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;

What makes us different?

  • Reference prizes and birthday present;

  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you:


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). title: Consultor de Governança
description:
Buscamos um profissional para liderar a estruturação e a manutenção do nosso ecossistema de dados. O foco principal será a implementação e gestão do Unity Catalog , estabelecendo políticas de governança que garantam a segurança, conformidade e qualidade dos dados utilizados em modelos de Analytics e Inteligência Artificial.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Unity Catalog: Configurar e administrar o Unity Catalog (Databricks) para garantir o controle de acesso centralizado (lineage, permissões e auditoria).
  • Políticas de Governança: Desenvolver e implementar políticas de governança de dados e IA, garantindo que o ciclo de vida dos dados esteja em conformidade com normas (como LGPD) e boas práticas de mercado.
  • Documentação Técnica: Atuar ativamente na criação de catálogos de dados, dicionários, diagramas de linhagem e manuais de processos. A documentação será um pilar central da entrega.
  • Governança de IA: Estabelecer diretrizes para o uso ético e seguro de modelos de IA, monitorando a qualidade dos dados de entrada (inputs) e a rastreabilidade dos modelos.
  • Segurança e Acessos: Definir e gerenciar perfis de acesso, garantindo que a democratização dos dados ocorra de forma segura.
  • Colaboração: Atuar como ponte entre as equipes de Engenharia de Dados, Cientistas de Dados e Stakeholders de negócio para garantir a integridade da informação.


Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

  • Experiência sólida com Databricks e configuração de Unity Catalog .
  • Conhecimento profundo em SQL e linguagens utilizadas em ambiente de dados (Python ou Scala).
  • Vivência com frameworks de Governança de Dados (DAMA-DMBOK, COBIT ou similares).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Catálogo de Dados e Linhagem (Data Lineage).
  • Entendimento de fluxos de MLOps e governança aplicada a modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade excepcional em escrita técnica e documentação.


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Databricks (Certified Data Engineer ou similar).
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de migração para ambientes de governança centralizada.


Perfil Desejado (Soft Skills)

  • Perfil Analítico: Capacidade de organizar grandes volumes de informação de forma lógica.
  • Atenção aos Detalhes: Rigor com a padronização e qualidade da documentação.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Capacidade de explicar políticas complexas de forma simples para diferentes áreas.

OBSERVAÇÕES

title: Systems Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Systems Engineer to work for our client. The ideal candidate aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications outlined below.


If you’re a systems expert who thrives in cloud‑driven, enterprise environments and you want a fully remote role with real technical ownership, this opportunity will give you the autonomy, complexity, and impact you’re looking for.


About the Role

Our client is seeking a skilled Systems Engineer with strong experience in virtualization, directory services, cloud environments, and enterprise server administration. In this role, you’ll support and optimize core infrastructure, improve system reliability, modernize environments, and play a critical part in supporting global teams.


This is the perfect position for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and working with a modern Microsoft‑centered stack.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage and optimize VMware environments, including configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting
  • Administer Active Directory, Azure Active Directory, identity management, and group policy
  • Support and maintain Windows Server environments across production and staging platforms
  • Implement and manage Azure cloud services, virtual machines, and hybrid integrations
  • Monitor system performance and ensure high availability of critical infrastructure

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Full Stack Sênior
description:
Descrição:

Título da Posição: Engenheiro(a) de Software Full Stack Sênior

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Modelo de trabalho: Home office

Número de vagas: 2


Formação mínima exigida: Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada, ou experiência equivalente.


Top 3 requisitos obrigatórios no currículo:

  • Forte experiência em desenvolvimento backend com atuação prática em serviços AWS.
  • Experiência comprovada no design e construção de sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis.
  • Experiência Full Stack com desenvolvimento moderno de front-end (NodeJS e React).


Visão geral do processo seletivo:

  • Entrevista de Design de Sistemas com o time de engenharia, com foco em arquitetura e design de sistemas.
  • Entrevista de Resolução de Problemas com o gerente contratante e um engenheiro, para avaliar capacidade de resolução de problemas, comunicação e alinhamento com a equipe.


Descrição da Vaga

Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe Autodesk Info360 está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior experiente para integrar o time. Nesta função, você ajudará a projetar, construir e escalar soluções cloud-native que impulsionam fluxos de trabalho modernos de gestão de recursos hídricos.

Esta é uma posição de alto impacto, com foco em backend e arquitetura em nuvem, mantendo também forte responsabilidade sobre experiências voltadas ao usuário.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver soluções inovadoras para gestão de recursos hídricos em fluxos de trabalho orientados a produto.
  • Projetar e construir serviços backend escaláveis e cloud-native na AWS, utilizando arquitetura híbrida entre containers e serverless.
  • Desenvolver código de qualidade para produção, testável, legível e eficiente.
  • Arquitetar e implementar processos complexos de carga e transformação de dados em alto volume e alta frequência, utilizando métodos e ferramentas ETL de ponta.
  • Fornecer orientação técnica e suporte aos colegas por meio de revisões de design, code reviews e colaboração contínua.
  • Projetar e desenvolver funcionalidades voltadas ao usuário utilizando React e ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento web.
  • Atuar como líder técnico(a) em iniciativas específicas de engenharia, contribuindo para decisões arquiteturais e de implementação.


Qualificações:

  • 10+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software, incluindo experiência relevante em arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Experiência comprovada no design e construção de sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis.
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação, tanto escrita quanto verbal, para articular ideias complexas a diferentes stakeholders.
  • Excelente capacidade analítica, de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico.
  • Profunda expertise em desenvolvimento cloud-native, com experiência prática em serviços AWS como Lambda, API Gateway e DynamoDB.
  • Experiência com AWS IoT é um diferencial.
  • Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) — Terraform ou CloudFormation — é um diferencial.
  • 3+ anos de experiência com React e seu ecossistema.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de Machine Learning é um diferencial.

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.
